def expired(self):
    now_tz = timezone.now()
    now_local = now_tz.astimezone(timezone.get_default_timezone())

    expired_conditions = (
        (self.date_expired and self.date_expired == now_local.date() and self.time_expired and self.time_expired < now_local.time()) or
        (self.date_expired is None and self.time_expired and self.time_expired < now_local.time()) or
        (self.date_expired and self.date_expired < now_local.date())
    )

    return expired_conditions
